en: Sepia-toned historic view of a European town square labeled 'Trento. Piazza delle Erbe.' The scene shows a market with people in early 20th-century clothing, wooden stalls, and carts. On the left is a neoclassical building with the sign 'BANCA COOPERATIVA'. To the right are multi-story buildings with shutters and awnings. In the background a tower rises above the roofs, with mountains visible further behind.
